_comment: Operator-owned route registry for Tri-AI. Copy to ~/.tri-ai/model-routes.json.
Every admission below is justified by a measurement in ~/.tri-ai/lane-bench.json
or by a run already recorded in ~/.tri-ai/ledger.jsonl. A route nobody has
watched succeed stays admitted:false, because `model_routes.resolve` refuses a
route that is not admitted and that refusal is the point of the file.
This carries no endpoint and no credential. Hermes config.yaml owns both;
Tri-AI records only which tested model identity a task was pinned to.

local-qwen-coder-14b._evidence: lane-bench: 3/3 correct, median 1.66s, 27.6 tok/s. Listed in hermes fallback_model with 131072 context, which the 40k-char specialist brief needs.

local-qwen-coder-7b._evidence: lane-bench: 3/3 correct, median 0.82s, 41.6 tok/s - the fastest correct lane measured. Already the reader model for the telegram and supervisor daemons.

local-devstral-24b._evidence: lane-bench: 3/3 correct, median 7.32s. One completed run in the ledger, so this identity is proven end to end through Hermes, not only on the bench harness.

omniroute-best-coding._evidence: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-30. Probed directly: HTTP 200 in 31.1s, but the response reported served model google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it - a diffusion model - and the reply ignored the instruction. `auto/*` is a router alias that selects its own downstream model, so it cannot name a tested identity. The 29 ledger runs recorded the alias, not what served them, so that history proves nothing about any model. Re-admit only as a specific downstream id.

omniroute-best-free._evidence: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-30 for the same reason as omniroute-best-coding: `auto/*` resolves downstream at request time, so the bench's 3/3 measured whatever it happened to select that day.

freellmapi-auto._evidence: lane-bench: 2/3 correct, median 37.56s, served as koboldcpp/gemma-4-31B-it-heretic. Held back on accuracy, not on cost: one failure in three is not a lane to pin a role to. Separately, freellmapi.stdout.log reports 'Checking 0 keys' on every pass, so it currently serves nothing.

local-qwen3-14b._evidence: lane-bench: 0/3 correct. Returns HTTP 200 with finish_reason=length and empty content - a reasoning model exhausting its budget. Refused until a higher max_tokens is measured.

local-gemma4-31b._evidence: lane-bench: 0/3 correct, median 99.95s. Above the measured 14.3-19.0 GB VRAM ceiling on this machine.

github-claude-opus-5._evidence: Real id confirmed live in the catalog (ctx 1,000,000 / out 64,000). NOT admitted: probed 2026-09-30 and returned HTTP 466 'This version of the Copilot CLI is no longer supported.' A version gate, not an entitlement wall - re-probe after the Copilot CLI is upgraded.

github-gpt-5-6-sol._evidence: Real id confirmed live (ctx 1,050,000 / out 128,000). NOT admitted: HTTP 466, same Copilot CLI version gate.

codex-gpt-5-6-sol._evidence: The ChatGPT subscription's road in, via OmniRoute's codex-app-server bridge. Codex CLI 0.159.2 installed on the desktop and reports 'Logged in using ChatGPT'. NOT admitted: probed HTTP 503 'Codex app-server transport is not...' - OmniRoute had not yet seen the newly installed CLI. Re-probe after restarting OmniRoute.
